units.title: Minimize marked grid cells under a missing-cell degree product
units.statement: In a grid of kp rows and kq columns with k at least p+1, if every unmarked cell lies in a row and column whose marked counts multiply to at least pq, the minimum marked count is kpq. A row with fewer than q marks would force too many marked columns; k disjoint complete p-by-q blocks attain equality.
steps: Assume fewer than kpq marks and choose a row with at most q-1 marks
Each unmarked column in that row must contain at least p+1 marks, contradicting the assumed total
Place k complete p-by-q marked blocks along the diagonal
